nodes.label: duc-dashboard.html scope & deliberate omissions
nodes.rationale: duc-dashboard.html is the static-Supabase replacement for the legacy Google Apps Script 'Bảng điều khiển đúc' Index.html screen only. Other original screens (IPQC submission, QC manager, NCP detail, mobile, weekly plan) live in separate files. Deliberately omitted: (1) ensurePersonnelInMaster_ auto-write of hand-typed personnel names back to KHSX Master — free-text names still save fine, just no future autosuggest outside the session; (2) the entire NCP (non-conforming product) flow — original Index.html had no entry point for it; (3) IPQC result submission form/standard management — original only shows a 'waiting IPQC' badge sourced from duc_get_ipqc_due_by_id_dong; (4) Google Docs->PDF end-shift report replaced with in-browser window.print()+@media print from duc_end_shift data; (5) Google Sheet weekly report replaced by client-side HTML summary table aggregated from duc_lich_su_san_xuat (only closed shifts appear); (6) duc_acquire_lock/duc_release_lock exist server-side but were never called by original Index.html, so left unwired; (7) '⚡ Nạp kế hoạch từ KHSX tuần' was restored, reading duc_khsx_tuan_plan (entered via khsx-tuan.html) instead of the original Google Sheet.

nodes.label: mobile.html deliberate simplifications
nodes.rationale: mobile.html is the static-Supabase 1:1 replacement for legacy Mobile.html (single-machine-per-screen phone UI). Simplifications matching duc-dashboard.html decisions: (1) dropped the Apps-Script-served PWA manifest (?asset=manifest) since this is a real static file on GitHub Pages — theme-color/apple-* meta tags suffice for 'Add to Home Screen'; (2) QR label printing now points TEM_PRINT_URL at intem.html instead of the old Apps Script flow; (3) dropped ensurePersonnelInMaster_ since there is no longer a master-data write path (master_employees is managed separately) — hand-typed names still save as free text, just lose next-time autosuggest; (4) machine/product/personnel/mold dropdowns now read directly from master_machines/master_products/master_employees/duc_shot_khuon (already migrated) instead of calling an api_bootstrap RPC. Also fixed an oversized root font-size (was hardcoded 48px, ~3x normal reading size) causing overflow on real phones — reverted to a clamp(15px,4vw,17px) browser-normal base.

nodes.label: ipqc.html changes vs original Apps Script
nodes.rationale: ipqc.html replaces legacy Ipqc.html + IpqcCheckpoint.js, covering only the inspector's checkpoint-submission screen (QC manager/standards/NCP screens are out of scope, deferred to qc-manager.html). Changes: (1) original had to prompt the inspector to type their own email (localStorage-saved modal) because Google Apps Script's Session.getActiveUser() only returns email for users with script-edit rights — regular staff got blank. Now Supabase Auth provides a real logged-in identity, so the self-declare modal is dropped entirely — an improvement in identity trustworthiness, not a feature cut. (2) Evidence photos: original uploaded base64 to Apps Script which wrote to Google Drive (_uploadIpqcEvidence_); now the browser uploads directly to Supabase Storage bucket 'ipqc-evidence' (created in migration_phase_D0_foundation.sql), gets a public URL, and passes the URL array into duc_submit_ipqc_check via p_anh_urls, per the design recorded in migration_phase4_step4. (3) The inspection queue (formerly getIpqcQueue_) filters to the 'currently active id_dong' per machine including paired molds; no existing public RPC/view covers this exactly (duc_get_ipqc_due_by_id_dong from step9 only serves the dashboard badge and excludes not-yet-due checkpoints, which the queue needs to show as 'upcoming') — so this page reads duc_ca_hien_tai + duc_ipqc_checkpoint directly (both have public read RLS) and computes the active-id_dong set client-side, replicating server logic _getActiveIdDongSet_ (latest row_seq per machine plus paired rows via khuon_kep_voi). (4) Business-rule validation (OK requires all-pass; NG/warning requires >=1 fail plus mandatory note) was re-added server-side inside duc_submit_ipqc_check itself (migration_phase4_step12), since the public RPC is called directly by the browser and can no longer rely solely on trusted Apps Script server-side checks.
nodes.norm_label: ipqc.html changes vs original apps script

nodes.label: intem.html 2026-08-14 optimization update
nodes.rationale: intem.html replaces legacy 'Intem QR' Apps Script (Code.gs + Index.html). 2026-08-14 update: (1) split into two tabs, 'In Tem' (create new label) and 'Tra cứu Tem' (lookup/edit/reprint/delete existing labels) — previously one combined form; (2) lookup tab adds direct camera QR scanning (jsQR + getUserMedia, same approach as chuyencongdoan.html) in addition to manual Tag No entry — auto-looks-up on successful scan; (3) 'Nguyên liệu' (material) auto-fills from master_products.nguyen_lieu when a product code is chosen (new column managed via quan-ly-danh-muc.html Products tab) — still manually editable after autofill, not locked; (4) product category 'Sản phẩm đang phát triển' (in-development) now prints a black-background/white-text label instead of always white background — Tag No prefix D-TKD (in development) vs TKD (mass production) is reused to infer the category on lookup/reprint since duc_tem has no separate loai_sp column (see migration_phase4_step2_intem.sql). QR generation library (qrcode-generator) is CDN-loaded but SVG drawing logic (buildQrRects/buildLabelSvg) is unchanged from the original. Accepts prefill via query string (?maSP=..&tenSP=..&mayDuc=..&nguoiTT=..&soKhuon=..) when opened from the 🖨 button on duc-dashboard.html, populating the 'In Tem' tab.
